scope: The independently implemented indexed native table syntax and retained Resolve calculus, with the existing amplitude-expression interpretation.
authority: Agda datatype and rule definitions below, not this transcription. Exhaustiveness is relative to these definitions; admission and source parameters remain explicit.

formation.rule: h:Header; children:(i:Arity h)->Node(Inputs h i) |- table-node h children : Node(Result h)
formation.equality: Cubical type-theoretic equality of the full dependent syntax/package; neither equal scalar readouts nor equal value types erase constructors or retained witnesses.
formation.quantifiers: For every supplied universe level, header parameters and well-founded typed child family. Arity may be infinite; a finite number of schemas is not a finite-state or finite-branching assertion.

rules.premises: F j for EVERY j:I, including unselected branches
rules.supplied: Index domain, full package family and selected index
Index domain and full package family

rules.parameters: a,b:Package; e:Ty a equiv Ty b; p:e(value a)=value b
rules.supplied: Actual equivalence e and pointed compatibility witness p

rules.output: inverse-comparison a b e p, retaining original comparison

rules.parameters: a,b,c; e:Ty a equiv Ty b; f:Ty b equiv Ty c; pointed witnesses p,q
rules.output: compose-comparisons a b c e f p q, retaining both comparisons
rules.supplied: Shared middle package and actual witnesses

rules.premises: path-package g x y p and path-package g x y q
rules.output: higher-package g x y p q alpha
rules.supplied: Actual higher witness alpha; not inferred from endpoints

rules.parameters: c,d:Graph; e:Value c equiv Value d; x,y:Value c
rules.premises: Package of the actual equivalence e
rules.output: lift-paths c d e x y, retaining e

rules.parameters: I; J:I->Type l; F:(i:I)->J i->Package; v:Pi_i Sigma_j Ty(F i j)
rules.premises: Every F i j AND the marked left-hand package with value v
rules.output: Pointed comparison Pi_i Sigma_j F(i,j) equiv Sigma_f Pi_i F(i,f(i))
rules.supplied: Full dependent family and the actual left-hand value v

rules.parameters: I; F,H:I->Package; e_i and p_i pointed comparisons; selected i:I
rules.output: Pointed E comparison, retaining the full family of comparisons
rules.supplied: Pointwise equivalences, compatibility witnesses and selected index

rules.parameters: I; F,H:I->Package; e_i and p_i pointed comparisons
rules.output: Pointed Pi comparison, retaining the full family of comparisons

derivations.rule: a:Admit q |- seed a : Resolve q
r:Rule; ds:(i:Arity r)->Resolve(input r i) |- apply r ds : Resolve(output r)
derivations.retains: Full rule parameters and every premise derivation

source_policy.rule: A literal requires its actual certificate. No fallback admits arbitrary packages.
source_policy.empty_policy: Empty admission does not imply empty closure: a zero-arity P application has no premise obligations.
source_policy.s4_generation: Not established. Supplying a type, map, equivalence, witness or admission certificate is recorded as an input, not counted as generation from S4.

coverage_witnesses.claim: All eight legacy Code forms correspond to native Graphs.
Complete packages, including selected values and syntax, correspond.
All twelve legacy rule parameter spaces correspond to native Rule.
Legacy and native retained closures correspond, including arbitrary original admission policies via ForOldSeeds.

constructors.translation: Run.apply P-kind over Port={operator,left,right}; operator is a certified seed and children are translated recursively

amplitude_interpretation.supplied: Factor type and factor weights; arbitrary target coefficient algebra in the generic interpreter, or the constructed Word semiring in the component bridge.
amplitude_interpretation.nonclaim: A P application retains operator and operand records; it does not derive scalar addition or multiplication from an unlabelled table. Component multiplication is separately constructed by recursion in ComponentArithmetic.

external_boundaries: This is exhaustive for the named native datatypes, not all repository sector operations.
No completeness theorem currently maps the nine-row comparison-successor policy contract into these native rules.

The retained-path ledger and natural component arithmetic now have exhaustive definition censuses and computational rules in semantic-extensions.json. The path ledger's operational interpretation into native Resolve remains open.
No finite serialization or equality-decision procedure for arbitrary supplied types, functions or higher witnesses is asserted.
